title: Sequential Monte Carlo approximations of Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao gradient flows
abstract: arXiv:2506.05905v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling from a probability distribution $\pi$. It is well known that this can be written as an optimisation problem over the space of probability distribution in which we aim to minimise the Kullback--Leibler divergence from $\pi$. We consider several partial differential equations (PDEs) whose solution is a minimiser of the Kullback--Leibler divergence from $\pi$ and connect them to well-known Monte Carlo algorithms. We focus in particular on PDEs obtained by considering the Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry over the space of probabilities and show that these lead to a natural implementation using importance sampling and sequential Monte Carlo. We propose a novel algorithm to approximate the Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao flow of the Kullback--Leibler divergence and conduct an extensive empirical study to identify when this algorithm outperforms other popular Monte Carlo algorithms.

translated_title: Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao梯度流的序贯蒙特卡洛近似
translated_abstract: 我们考虑从一个概率分布 $\pi$ 中采样的问题。众所周知，该问题可以表述为概率分布空间上的一个优化问题，其目标是最小化与 $\pi$ 之间的Kullback-Leibler散度（KL散度）。我们考虑了若干偏微分方程（PDE），其解是使KL散度最小化的分布，并将这些方程与著名的蒙特卡洛算法联系起来。我们特别关注通过在概率分布空间上引入Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao几何所得到的PDE，并证明这些方程可以自然地通过重要性采样和序贯蒙特卡洛方法来实现。我们提出了一种新颖的算法来近似KL散度的Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao流，并进行了广泛的实证研究，以确定该算法在何种情况下优于其他流行的蒙特卡洛算法。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao几何、利用重要性采样与序贯蒙特卡洛的新算法来近似KL散度梯度流以实现分布采样，并通过广泛的实证研究揭示了该算法优于其他流行蒙特卡洛算法的适用场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel algorithm using importance sampling and sequential Monte Carlo to approximate the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao gradient flow of the KL divergence for sampling from a target distribution, and conducts extensive empirical studies to identify when it outperforms other popular Monte Carlo algorithms.
